books.title: Crystal Healing for the Heart: Gemstone Therapy for Physical, Emotional, and Spiritual Well-Being
books.author: Nicholas Pearson
books.description: Nicholas looks at the heart as both an organ and a spiritual centre, linking its four chambers to the four elements and the heart chakra. Exercises and meditations with more than 60 stones work on emotional strength, will, forgiveness and relationships.

left_out: Holy Gems & Lapidary Medicine in History (College of Psychic Studies, https://www.collegeofpsychicstudies.co.uk/workshops/learning-about-crystals/holy-gems-and-healing-crystals/?id=6775): the page dates it Sundays 15 and 22 November 2026, so it starts before 16 Nov. Not a health reason: it is a history class.
